recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Further changes for FHIR-15923 would be editorial unless a new RDF work-group decision changes the representation rules.
issue_request: FHIR-15923 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core RDF issue asking the RDF description page to show how contained resources are represented. Its resolution was to document the behavior by copying from one of the examples.
initial_application: The issue was applied by SVN revision 14465, mirrored as Git commit 951a0b4803dce99a5c63bca4b062301c7758feb4, which added a Representing Inline Resources section to source/rdf.html for GF#15923.
additional_context: source/rdf.html is active build content through source/hierarchy.xml and publish.ini. Later RDF page updates, including the 2022 FHIR-37937 update family and the 2025 W3C issue #170 rewrite, preserved and expanded the inline-resource discussion with Bundle, DomainResource.contained, local-reference, and relative-URI examples. Direct community searches found no conflicting FHIR-15923 record.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The current Inline Resources -- Bundled or contained section lists Bundle.entry.resource, DomainResource.contained, and Parameters.parameter.resource, then shows Bundle and contained ActivityDefinition Turtle examples using fhir:contained, fhir:l, and # local references.
